items.t: Teladoc Health (TDOC) Stock Still Looks Cheap Following Its 93% Slump
items.sum: Teladoc Health has seen its share price move through a sharp reset over recent years, which puts fresh focus on a simple question. Are the cash flows the business can reasonably generate enough to support where the stock trades today? Over the past 5 years the share price has fallen 92.8%, which makes the current valuation hinge heavily on what investors believe about Teladoc Health's future cash

items.t: Hims & Hers Stock Has Lost 47% in November. Is It Time to Buy the Dip?
items.sum: Revenue is surging, yet the market is dumping Hims & Hers at a record pace. Margins are collapsing, cash is draining, and $1.37 billion in convertible debt looms. What would have to go right for the selloff to look overdone?
